blogs.title: Building a Minimal, Self-Hosted Port-Forwarding Tool in Go
blogs.description: Build a self-hosted reverse port-forwarding tool in Go. Learn to handle WebSocket multiplexing, channel-based data streaming, and public-to-local traffic routing.

blogs.title: How to Create Your Own Blog Site Without It Sucking
blogs.description: A practical, no-database approach to building your own MDX-powered blog with GitHub, Bun, and a CDN — automated with GitHub Actions.
